data.long_meaning: Muniyandi is a Tamil name for the Hindu god of wisdom and learning. It is derived from the word 'muni', which means 'sage' or 'wise one'. Muniyandi is revered as the patron of scholars, students, and seekers of knowledge. He is also believed to bestow the qualities of wisdom, intelligence, and knowledge upon those who invoke him.
data.spiritual_meaning: Muniyandi represents the divine aspect of wisdom and knowledge. It is a reminder to seek knowledge and wisdom in all aspects of life, and to use this knowledge to serve others and uplift the world.
data.etymology: Muniyandi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muniyandi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
